basic_info.description: 2682 15th Avenue @ Wawona Street This spacious 3-bedroom/2 bathroom single family home is luxury living in desirable West Portal.It boasts original inlay work, high ceilings, and 2 floors of living space. This home features a full dining room, atrium, built-in cabinetry, new oven, split bathroom, master bedroom suite, washer & dryer, garage parking for 1 car and a back yard. Unit Features:* 2 Levels of living space* Hardwood floors in all common rooms* Wall-to-wall carpeting in all bedrooms* Master bedroom suite downstairs w/walk-in shower* Full dining room* Living room fireplace* Atrium with sky light* Built-in cabinetry* Kitchen features white tile & stainless steel appliances* Split bathroom with separated shower & bathtub* Large walk-in closet features built-in vanity* Parking for 1 car in attached garage* Washer & Dryer downstairs* Full backyard Great location close to West Portal with all of the conveniences one could desire. Great dining, boutique shopping, banks, post office, pharmacy and much more; this neighborhood is the place to be! Close to San Francisco State University, City College of San Francisco, Muni, and Stonestown. Rent: $4895.00Deposit: $7342.50 No pets & No Smoking. Minimum 1 (One) Year lease. Tenant pays all utilities. **Applications available at showing only. Completed applications, along with the $30 cash or money order processing fee per applicant, and $250 check for a holding deposit must be submitted to Anchor Realty directly. The holding deposit will be applied to the second months' rent if the application is approved and a lease signed. Agent cannot accept applications. ANCHOR REALTY, INC.WWW.ANCHOREALTYINC.
